items.title: 6.11.3 Reactions mein entropy ki tabdeeliyan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.11.3, printed pages 137-138, with Quick Check 6.9 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Kisi chemical reaction mein agar reactants aur products ki entropy ka muqabla karein to andaza laga sakte hain ke entropy change kitni hai aur entropy barhi ya ghati. Reaction ki entropy change jaanne ke liye yeh qaide (rules) hain:
Jab product mein solid liquid ya gas ban jaye to entropy change musbat hoti hai.
Agar products mein moles ki tadaad zyada ho to entropy change musbat hoti hai.

Agar reaction mein gas molecules ki tadaad badle to is ka bara asar hota hai, kyun ke gases ki entropy bohat zyada hoti hai. Gas molecules jitne zyada, un ki tarteeb ke tareeqe utne zyada aur entropy utni zyada.
Is system ki entropy barhti hai kyun ke ek gas (zyada entropy) ban rahi hai jab ke reactant, calcium carbonate, solid (kam entropy) hai. Kitab kehti hai ke aise reactions spontaneous hote hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Entropy ka barhna spontaneous hone ke haq mein jata hai, magar akela kaafi nahi. CaCO₃ ka tootna room temperature par khud nahi hota (Quick Check 6.9 (b) ka aakhri hissa yahi poochta hai); yeh sirf bohat zyada temperature par hota hai. Is ka faisla free energy (ΔG, topic 6.12) se hota hai.
Yahan system ki entropy barhne ki umeed hai kyun ke products mein gas ke moles (5) reactants (2) se zyada hain. Yeh bhi spontaneous process hai.
Entropy change ka nishan aur process ki spontaneity
Kisi substance ki entropy hamesha musbat hoti hai, lekin entropy change musbat bhi ho sakti hai aur manfi bhi.
Musbat entropy change (ΔS° = +ve) spontaneous process ki nishani hai.
Manfi entropy change (ΔS° = –ve) ka matlab hai molecules zyada tarteeb mein aa gaye aur be-tarteebi kam hui.
Lekin kuch reactions mein sirf entropy change se spontaneity ka pata nahi chalta, aur ek aur quantity chahiye jise free energy kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: a) In reactions mein entropy change musbat hogi ya manfi? (i) N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) (ii) 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g)
blocks.explanation: (i) Gas ke 4 moles 2 moles ban jate hain, is liye ΔS manfi. (ii) Gas ke 2 moles se 2 moles hi bante hain, is liye ΔS taqreeban zero (thoda musbat, kyun ke do mukhtalif gases banti hain).

blocks.prompt: b) In mein se kaun si tabdeeliyan ghaliban spontaneous hain? (i) khuli bottle se ammonia ki boo ka kamre mein phailna (ii) –10 °C par pani ka barf banna (iii) 20 °C par ethanol ka bhaap banna (iv) pani ka namak ke saath poori tarah milna (v) room temperature par limestone (CaCO₃) ka tootna
blocks.explanation: Spontaneous: (i), (ii), (iii) (khule bartan se aahista aahista) aur (iv). (v) spontaneous nahi; limestone room temperature par nahi toot-ta.

items: ΔS musbat: solid se liquid/gas bane, products mein zyada moles hon, ya gas molecules barhen (CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂; 2N₂O₅ → 4NO₂ + O₂).
Musbat ΔS spontaneity ke haq mein hai, magar aakhri faisla free energy se hota hai.
